contentText: Argentina will play Spain in the World Cup final on July 19 after Lionel Messi orchestrated a spectacular comeback against England in a semi-final with a dramatic ending. The defeat was another bitter blow for the Three Lions, who have reached at least the semi-final stage in four of their past five major tournaments without getting over the line. FRANCE 24's James Vasina tells us more about what to know.
